description: This file defines the ViewModel class AttachmentDialogViewModel used in an Android application to manage attachment data within a dialog. It provides methods to retrieve an attachment by note ID and path, and to update an attachment's description, interacting with the NoteRepository and utilizing coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AttachmentDialogViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class that manages attachment data for a dialog, providing methods to retrieve and update attachments associated with notes.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment from a note specified by note ID and attachment path.

methods.name: updateAttachmentDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a specific attachment within a note, asynchronously.
